paite: Huai ni in Deborah leh Abinoam tapa Barak in hiai la asa uhi:
heading: Debora Leh Barak La

paite: "Israel a makaite'n ma akaih lai un, amau ut thu a mite'n azuih lai un, TOUPA phat un!
Aw, nou kumpipate aw, ngaikhia un. Aw, nou heutute aw, bil na doh un. Kei mahmah in TOUPA pahtawi in la ka sa dia, TOUPA, Israelte' Pathian phat in la ka sa ding hi.
TOUPA, Seir gam a pan na hong paikhiak a, Edom loubuk a na hong pawt in, lei aling a, van ahong kia a, meipi'n vuah azusak uhi.
TOUPA ma ah tangte achim ua, TOUPA, Israelte' Pathian ma ah Sinai Tang mah leng.
Anath tapa Samgar dam lai nite leh Jael dam lai nite in lamliante tot louh in a-om ua, zin-le-lengte lah lam neute ah apai uhi.
Israel gamte atul khin a, akhuate luah louh in atul khin hi, kei Deborah ka gamtang a, Israel gam nu ka gamtat masiah.
Amau pathian thakte atel ua; huchi in kulh kongkhak bul ah kidouna a-om a; Israel gam a mi singli lak ah lum leh tei muh in a-om hia?
Ka lungsim Israelte vaihawmpa, mipite lak a lungluttak a kipiate lam ah a-om hi. TOUPA phat un.
Pau un, nou sabiltung kang tung a tuangte, nou vaihawmna a tute leh lampi a paite.
Thalkap mite husa zak phak louh, tui tawina mun ah TOUPA thil dik hihte agengen ua, Israel gam tung a thil dik ahihte ngei. Huchi in TOUPA mipite kulh kongkhakte lam ah apaisuk ding uhi.
Thou in, thou in, Deborah; thou in, thou in, la sa in. Thou in, Barak, thou inla, Abinoam tapa, na salmatte pi in.
Huchi in mi omlaite mipite lak a miliante tung ah thu aneisak a, TOUPA'N mihat tung ah thu hon neisak hi.
Ephraim a pan zungzam khat Amalek dou a-om a, Benjamin, na mite lak a mite'n nang hon zui uh, Makir a pan gam vaihawmte ahong paisuk ua, Zebulun a pan laigelhmi chiangkhun tawi mite ahong paisuk uhi.
Deborah kiang ah Issakar miliante a-om ua; Issakar leh Barak mah leng. Amah phaizang lam a sawlsuk ahi a, Reuben pawlte ahihleh nakpitak in akingaihtuah lai uhi.
Bangziak a belam huang lak a tu nilouh, belamhon ham ngai ding lel in maw? Reuben pawlte a ding in lungtang a kingaihtuahna thupitak a-om hi.
Gileadte Jordan gal ah a-om nilouh ua; bangziak a Dante longte a om nilouh uh ahia? Asherte tuipi piau ah atu kinken ua, atuipiaute ah a-om nilouh uhi.
Zebulun leh Naphtali leng mun sang pawn a sih ngap gigete ahi uh.
Kumpipate'n ahong dou ua, Kanaan kumpipate'n Meggiddo tui kiang, Taanak ah adou ua; sum himhim ala kei uhi.
Van a pan ahon dou ua; aksite'n amun ua kipan Sisera ahon dou uh.
Kishon lui in amaute ataimang a, nidanglai lui, Kishon lui in, Aw ka kha, hattak in pai zel in.
Huchi in sakolte akipek thotthot ua, sakol hatte atawmtawm ziak un.
Meroz hamsiat un," TOUPA angel in achi, huai a tengte nakpitak in hamsiat un. TOUPA panpih ding, TOUPA'N mihattak adouna panpih dia ahong louh ziak un.
Numei lak ah Jael, Ken mi Heber zi nuamsapen ahi, numei puanin a tengte lak ah amah minuamsapen ahi.
Tui ahong ngen a, ama'n nawitui apia hi: miliante' nou in nawituidat ana pia hi.
Kilhna atawi a, ataklam in nasemmi sek; sek in Sisera akhen a, alu ah akhen pailet a, ahi, ahaizek ah akhen a, akhental vengvong hi.
Akhebul ah akun a, apuk a, alum a; akhebul ah akun a, apukta a; apukna mun ah asita hi.
Sisera nu bel tawlet ah adak a, vathangkalh awng ah asam a, "Bang achia kangtalai hong tunghak ahia? Bang achia akangtalai khe zekai ahia?" achi hi.
Anumei pilte'n ana dawng ua, ahi, amah dawng ding in ahong nawn ua:

Amuzouta kei ua hia? Gallak kihawmta lou uhia? Michih in nungak khat hiam nih chiat; Sisera tan ding gallak puan ze tuamtuam, gallak puan ze kilawm, ze tuamtuam, gallak ngawng a velh ding puan, alangnih a ze kilawm, ze tuamtuam, chi in.
"Huchibang in aw, TOUPA, na melmate tengteng mangthang vek uhen. Amah itte bel hattak a pai, nisa bang hi uhen,” achi uhi. Huchi in kum sawmli sung gam galmuang in a-om hi.
